name: Rate the matches
summary: Friends rate someone's dating matches on drawn profile cards: their takes swing a red-to-green flag meter and a flag on each card gives the verdict.
useWhen: a friend shares dating matches or a profile and asks the chat what they think
'rate my matches', 'red flag or green flag', 'should I text him back'
dontUseWhen: real photos of real strangers are the point (never draw a real person)

params.subject: whose matches, first name
params.profiles: 1-3 x {name, age, info, prompt, answer, look, takes: up to 4 x {who, text, weight -20..20, at ms}}
